subject: Clamp TCP_KEEPINTVL and simplify TCP_KEEPALIVE_ABORT_THRESHOLD on Solaris (#292)
reason: The change is confined to the #ifdef __sun branch of anetKeepAlive() in src/anet.c (clamping TCP_KEEPINTVL to >=10s and simplifying TCP_KEEPALIVE_ABORT_THRESHOLD). On the Linux CI platform this code is not even compiled — Linux uses the separate TCP_KEEPIDLE/TCP_KEEPINTVL/TCP_KEEPCNT path, which is unchanged. No scenario run by the fuzzer can reach the changed behaviour, and the change affects no replies, replication, or persistence; it only adjusts kernel keepalive socket options on Solaris.
